hero.title: APKLeaks for AI Agents
hero.subtitle: Find secrets, API keys, tokens and endpoints in Android APKs — re-architected for AI agents. Every surface speaks JSON, self-describes in one call, and grades its own findings.

home.whySubtitle: Upstream APKLeaks is a solid human CLI — but when the operator is an LLM, the contract breaks. This fork wraps the same engine with an AI-native layer.

engine.title: Built on Proven Engine
engine.desc: Fork of dwisiswant0/apkleaks — scanning engine unchanged, adds an AI-native layer on top.

mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.desc: 12 tools, 4 resources, 4 prompts — native tool calls via Model Context Protocol, no Bash subprocess.

cli.title: Structured-JSON CLI
cli.desc: 13 subcommands with deterministic JSON envelope — works from any shell-capable agent.

skills.title: 9 Rev-Skills
skills.desc: Auto-discovered on plugin install. Triggered by intent, chain seamlessly.

home.loopNote: Every step returns ok + a stable error_code — the agent never parses natural language to decide what to do next.
home.ctaDesc: Install the plugin and scan your first APK in under a minute.

features.title: Feature Tree at a Glance
features.subtitle: A fork of upstream APKLeaks, re-architected as an AI-native toolkit. Rendered by tools/feature_tree.py (pure stdlib).

contract.title: Agent Contract
contract.subtitle: Every response follows the same predictable structure — deterministic, machine-readable, no prose parsing needed.

ok.title: ok flag + stable error_code
ok.desc: Single boolean for branching; stable machine-matchable codes (FILE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_APK, NO_FINDINGS…)

schema.title: schema self-discovery
schema.desc: One call returns all subcommands, parameters & return structures — agent learns the full API without reading source

critical.title: has_critical triage
critical.desc: Findings pre-sorted critical→info; flag for one-branch triage; filter with -s critical / severity parameter

envelope.title: Response Envelope
envelope.subtitle: Every subcommand and tool returns one of:

skills.title: 9 Reverse-Engineering Skills
skills.subtitle: Auto-discovered on plugin install. Triggered by intent, chain seamlessly. Each follows progressive-disclosure: lean SKILL.md on trigger, deep reference.md on demand.

anatomy.title: Progressive-Disclosure Anatomy
anatomy.subtitle: Every skill follows the canonical anthropics/skills anatomy:
anatomy.skill: SKILL.md — lean entry loaded on trigger: overview, execution flow, hard rules.
anatomy.ref: references/reference.md — deep docs read on demand: full catalogs, error codes, edge cases.
anatomy.license: LICENSE.txt — Apache-2.0, mirrors root LICENSE per spec.

install.title: Install — Plug It Into Your Agent
install.subtitle: Not "install then run manually" — this wires the tool into your agent's runtime.

plugin.title: Recommended: Claude Code Plugin
plugin.subtitle: One step registers all 9 skills + the MCP server. No manual settings.json editing.

manual.title: Alternative: Manual MCP Server
manual.subtitle: For local development on this repo, or non-plugin runtimes.

cli.title: CLI Only — No Setup Required
cli.subtitle: For any agent with Bash access, just run the CLI directly. Zero config.
